title: GET /api/decks returns ALL decks (including private) to any authenticated reader — enables enumeration
description: Any authenticated reader can enumerate every deck in the system.

title: Build output bypasses publish-link verification
description: The published-deck gate is enforced on the HTML route but the build-output route bypasses that if the deck UUID is known. Combined with H1, an attacker can identify published decks and access output directly.
